greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: A [Necromancer], yes — and before your hand drifts to that sword, no, nothing in this square has been raised. I merely occupy the cheapest air the Guild permits. Pisces Jealnv. You reek of a body that has never once held mana. Curious. You want something.

text_variants.text: Fewer eyes on me after dark. I prefer it that way. The square empties, the lamps get lit, and I can work through my notes without an audience.
The pupil returns. Hm. Your channels are adequate now. Do try not to embarrass the discipline in public.
Back again. Either you are braver than the Watch or you have reconsidered your ignorance. Which is it?
You have the look of someone who felt something they cannot name. I get that look often, usually right before someone asks me to explain it for free. Go on, then. Tell me what you sensed.
My other pupil. The Watch keeps a count of my acquaintances, and you are on it now. How fares the honest art?

text_variants._comment: Spec 4 (Task 6.1): three CONTEXTUALIZING reactions, one per lattice counter, appended in pilgrimage order under last-match-wins so the most recent discovery opens. He never assigns and never assembles -- each line reacts to a piece the REGION handed the player, and the picture waits for Act V.
text_variants.text: Ward-lore from a hedge witch. Do not make that face — hers is older than the Guild's, and she fed hers too. Fed. That word keeps recurring.

Hedault read your frame unbidden and charged you nothing, and from that man a waived fee is appetite. I know the feeling. He is better at settings than I will ever be. I am still deciding what to do with knowing it.

A Drake forge taught you in an afternoon what my tuition has been circling for a month. They feed their runes. Feed them, on a schedule. Maintenance, they call it. I am revising my rates. Downward. The new schedule is chalked on my slate already.

text_variants._comment: Act V: two thread-current arms, appended after the lattice trio so last-match-wins keeps his greeting on the newest state. Neither can shadow a pinned canonical -- both counters are Act V's own, unheld by every shipped fixture.
text_variants.text: I am ready when you are. Down past the halls, to that seal. Do not let me forget the rope; I will pretend I never needed reminding.
Settled, then. I intend to write it up at unbearable length, and you will appear in the footnotes. Generously. Twice.

options.text: You're a mage. Teach me to cast.
You hold yourself like a swordsman more than a scholar.
Something's come through our pantry door. Will you look at it?
I read the wardwork myself: a spatial anchor, something that remembers being elsewhere.
I can read that dusty scroll now. A warding treatise — about a door.
About the pantry door — I understand what it is now. Where does that leave me?
I have the stone and Krshia's catalyst. Now what?

options._comment: Spec 7 amendment 1 re-copy: the shipped id heard_pisces_second_door stays, the 'second door' fiction does not. What the player found under the city is a sealed rune-door full of wardwork by the same hand.
options.text: There's wardwork sealed under the dungeon. Same hand as our pantry frame.
The other art. The one you actually practice. Teach me.
I meant what I asked. Teach me the dead art.

options._comment: Spec 4 (Task 6.1) THE SPINE START. The shipped producer of door_awakened is sleep_beat.gd:142 (three study sleeps), so the attune-completion surface is this arm: the player reports the awakening the morning after. The spine 'starts from Pisces at door_awakened' and the foreshadow copy is a SPOKEN line, so a code-side bank could not have carried it. Appended LAST so every cursor-pinned canonical over this hub is byte-identical (no shipped fixture carries door_awakened AND opens this graph).
options.text: The Door woke. It reaches past Liscor now.

options._comment: Act V (#270 beat 1, spec 7 amendment 2) THE DESCENT ASK. Gate is ALL THREE lattice counters, which is the amendment's 'fires when lattice_forge_rune banks' in data terms -- the forge rune is last in the spine's own order. NO bank on this option: seal_descent_agreed rides the ACCEPT below, so a player who opens the pitch and walks away can come back (hide_when is the accept's counter, not a read-flag). Appended LAST so every cursor-pinned canonical stays byte-identical.
options.text: Everywhere I've been, someone was feeding a ward. Riverfarm, Invrisil, Pallass. Tell me what that means.

options._comment: #15's BRIDGE BEAT: the one place his Horns membership is said out loud, in his own mouth. Gate is horns_party_formed -- the player has met the team, so the question is earned, not exposition. Appended LAST so every cursor-pinned canonical stays byte-identical. CANON BAR: names no delve, no casualty, no date -- membership and its terms only.
options.text: Ksmvr counts you as a Horn of Hammerad. Do you?

horns_bridge.speaker: Pisces
horns_bridge.text: Horns of Hammerad. Yes. There is a name on their roster and a share of their debts attached to it. That is membership. I am not in the hole with them because the interesting half of the work is here — things that are written do not read themselves, and nobody else in this city can. Ceria calls that being hired. Ceria also calls my handwriting adequate, so her judgement is not beyond dispute.

horns_bridge_two.speaker: Pisces
horns_bridge_two.text: Four. Yvlon holds what is falling, Ksmvr counts what is left, Ceria decides, and I am told afterwards. The arrangement has kept four people alive who had no business remaining so. I audited the arrangement for a month, expecting to find the error. There is no error. I have not repeated the audit.

spine_start._comment: FORESHADOW, NEVER ASSIGN (spec 4 copy discipline): he names an appetite and a direction, no list, no errand. 'wardwork by the same hand' is the Act V seal, kept oblique.
spine_start.speaker: Pisces
spine_start.text: The Door will show you how far it wants to go. And somewhere under this city is wardwork by the same hand, still fed, still waiting. I intend to understand both. Go — see where it reaches.

descent_ask._comment: #270 beat 1. The scroll leg (scroll_secret_shared) is an OR-ENRICHMENT, never a requirement: with the treatise read he connects it explicitly, without it his own arithmetic carries the ask, so the [Mage] line stays optional. Spoiler bar: he names an appetite and a hand, never what is on the other end.
descent_ask.speaker: Pisces
descent_ask.text: Three regions taught you the same word in three accents and not one of them noticed doing it. A witch feeds hers, milk and a word. An enchanter prices the draw and calls it craftsmanship. Pallass bills it as maintenance. Maintenance. Under this city is wardwork by the hand that cut our frame, and it has been drawing since before Liscor had walls. I want to read it standing in front of it.

text_variants.text: Your treatise said it in the third paragraph and I chose to admire the penmanship instead. Bound, fed, and waiting, with no term given. Three regions have since handed me the same word in three accents, and the hand that cut our frame cut the seal under this city. I want to read it standing in front of it.

options.text: What do you expect to find?
Then we go down. I'll walk you to it.

descent_expect.speaker: Pisces
descent_expect.text: Something that was fed on purpose, by people who expected to be dead long before it stopped needing feeding. Past that I have guesses, and I do not perform guesses in public. The honest answer is thinner than I would like.

options.text: Then we go down. I'll walk you to it.

descent_agreed._comment: Ceria's shipped 'bring his own rope' pool line, paid off. The safe-line claim is not new lore: pisces_second_door_study_2 (street.json talk_pool) already says he mapped the gauntlet during the study sleeps.
descent_agreed.speaker: Pisces
descent_agreed.text: Good. I have walked that gauntlet twice and marked the safe line myself, so we will not be dying of a flagstone. Bring your own rope. I am not carrying yours; I have a spine to preserve and a reputation that assumes I never lift anything.

second_door_bridge._comment: Spec 7 amendment 1: the counter id heard_pisces_second_door is SHIPPED and frozen, so it keeps its id -- but the fiction is dead. Every surface it touches now reads 'the seal's wardwork', never a second door and never another portal. Node id kept for the same freeze reason.
second_door_bridge.speaker: Pisces
second_door_bridge.text: The same hand, then, on both sides of the city. Two workings, one wardwright, and no version of that I can make boring. I should very much like to read that wardwork myself — after you have slept. My notes on our frame want reorganizing before I stand in front of its sibling.

options.text: I'll let you get back to it.

door_consult.speaker: Pisces
door_consult.text: A door that changes its mind about where it goes. How very like this city — even the fixtures have moods. You could bleed for my curiosity, if that is your instrument. You could attempt to talk me into caring, which has been done, rarely. Or prove you can read a ward without my help, and I will be forced to take you seriously. Choose, and do not waste my morning.

options.text: I'll clear whatever's coming through myself.
Come look at it yourself. This is your kind of magic.
I'll read the wardwork myself, then.

consult_fight_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_fight_response.text: Bleeding it is. Predictable, but effective. Go on, then. I shall be here with my notes. Do try to leave the frame intact.

consult_talk_pitch.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_pitch.text: You want me to walk into someone's pantry and grope at a wild ward with my bare senses. No. I have wards of my own I would rather keep.

options.text: It's not asking much. You'd know in a glance.

consult_talk_argue.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_argue.text: A glance. Hm. If it truly reads as spatial and not necrotic, I could examine it without touching a thing. Fine — for the intellectual insult of not knowing. Do not mistake this for a favor.

options.text: Then it's settled — I'll cover your time instead. (5 gold)

consult_talk_done.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_done.text: A spatial anchor. Crude. Fascinating. Whoever built your inn, adventurer, built it on something that remembers being elsewhere.

consult_skill_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_response.text: Read it yourself, then. [Observe] the frame close, and mind that the pattern does not repeat the same way twice. Report back if you actually understand what you saw. I shall judge whether you do.

consult_skill_report.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_report.text: Hm. Correct. Aggravatingly correct. You have the eye, if not the training. Do not let it go to your head. The training is where the real work is.

pisces_fence.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence.text: Observant. A rapier, in fact, before any of this. My father's trade — his grip, his footwork, his opinions on both. I set it down for magic, and he has yet to forgive either of us. The footwork stayed. The weight still goes forward when I argue, and the back heel comes up. I stopped trying to train that out.

pisces_fence_two.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence_two.text: I sold the blade years ago, under circumstances I will call instructive. I do not miss it, exactly. The hands remember it at odd hours. This morning, in fact, halfway through a citation.

lesson_mana.speaker: Pisces
lesson_mana.text: Then attend. Every living thing carries a reserve — mana. You will feel it as a second breath: a well that empties as you work a spell and refills when you sleep. A warrior spends stamina; you now spend this. Waste it and you are left waving your hands at the air.

options.text: How is casting different from swinging a blade?

lesson_casting.speaker: Pisces
lesson_casting.text: A sword asks only your arm. A spell asks your mind and your mana in the same instant. Intent comes first — what the spell is for, held plainly. Then shape. Shape is where the hands and the diction earn their keep — no, that understates it: shape is where pupils fail. Cost you do not choose; the magic takes it when intent and shape are ready, and if you have fumbled either, you have merely gestured. Precision, traveler. Whatever the Watch mutters about my craft, it taught me precision.

options.text: So what do I cast first?

lesson_light.speaker: Pisces
lesson_light.text: [Light]. Always [Light]. It is cheap and it is obedient. When it fails, it merely goes out — no fire, no inquest, which for a man of my reputation is the deciding virtue. Kindle one steady orb and you have proven the channel holds. Master that, and only then do we discuss the interesting spells.

options.text: I'm ready. Show me the words.

sealed.speaker: Pisces
sealed.text: There. The channel is opened — crudely, but opened. Sleep on it; the shape settles by morning, as these things do. And, traveler, when your first orb kindles, hold it a moment before you let it go. I still do, every casting. Nobody has ever asked me why.

door_recap.speaker: Pisces
door_recap.text: Then attend, because I dislike repeating myself. The door remembers being elsewhere; what it lacks is an anchor to remember by. East across the floodplains, well past the gate road, there is a seam of old dressed stone in the open grass — a ruin, collapsed and rude, but its plinth still cradles an anchor stone. Retrieve it. Krshia's resonant catalyst will attune the pairing. The ruin itself was indifferently cut before it ever collapsed. Mind the overhangs going in.

options.text: East past the gate road. Understood.

door_recap_two.speaker: Pisces
door_recap_two.text: I have standards. They have never required me to visit. The Guild survey wrote it down as a seam and moved on; I read the same survey and saw a doorframe standing with its building gone. Go and look at the plinth. It will settle which of us read the page correctly.

door_attune.speaker: Pisces
door_attune.text: Then the scholarship is done and the tedium begins. Keep both near the door, and rest. Rest is the instruction; I am aware of how it sounds. Attunement is a residency — the frame learns the stone the way a house learns its family: overnight, and more than once. Sleep. Let the inn do the part no [Mage] can rush.

options.text: Sleep on it. Literally. Got it.

necro_deflect._comment: Two-visit deflect->teach per spec §5; the deflect option banks asked_about_necromancy and hides itself, which reveals the second ask on the next hub entry.
necro_deflect.speaker: Pisces
necro_deflect.text: No. — You mistake me: not 'no, never.' No as a complete sentence, which is more courtesy than this city has ever extended to my discipline. Necromancy is the study they exile you for, and I will not hand it over as a flourish for your repertoire. Ask me again when you have decided you mean it.

necro_teach.speaker: Pisces
necro_teach.text: You are aware of what they call me in this square. You have heard the Watch's tone when my name comes up. And still you ask. Very well — sit. First principle: the dead do not mind. The living mind enormously, and you will learn to weather that, or you will quit. Bone answers a precise mind. Yours is nearly adequate.

necro_taught._comment: 'A fencer's trick first, a spell second' = the WB [Flash Step] teaching-beat callback (spec §5). 'Sleep will settle the argument' = diegetic bed signpost (#130 family).
necro_taught.speaker: Pisces
necro_taught.text: We begin with a dart of bone. Unglamorous, honest, and it has preserved my life more often than any duel. Your channels will fight the grammar of it; sleep will settle the argument. And — in time, if your footwork ever deserves it, I may show you the step that made me difficult to duel. A fencer's trick first, a spell second. When next we meet: fewer questions, better posture.

scroll_secret.speaker: Pisces
scroll_secret.text: Let me see that. Hm. Hmm. Whoever wrote this treatise anchored their wards the way I would — which is to say, correctly — and the subject of their treatise is your pantry. Do you understand? Someone documented that door before your innkeeper was born. It has been bound, fed, and waiting a very long time. I went looking for the paragraph that names what all the feeding is for. There is no such paragraph. I have read the treatise twice through to be certain, and I will read it again tonight.

options.text: That's enough dread for one day.
